question.knowledge_point: Calculating the Area of an Isosceles Right Triangle
question.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13945897/assets/4aa952124ddaaa1dc2a54ebb4601255ae42346a9e02f02391c05453a81542505.png)

What is the area of the right triangle $ABC$ shown above?
question.worked_solution:
Since $m∠A=m∠C={45}^{∘}$ and $AB=BC,$ we have an isosceles right triangle. 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13945897/assets/670afdec3633984b2fb493706e762740062348ccbdd0f56df14e3add3d4bbd23.png)

Therefore, the area of the triangle is

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =\frac{1}{2}AB\cdot BC \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot {13}^{2} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\cdot 169 \\  & =84.5\,.\end{aligned}
$$
